sources.entry: agents-observe by Joe Johnston - A real-time Claude Code observability dashboard installed as a plugin: it registers hooks across the full session lifecycle (tool calls, subagent start/stop, task and permission events) and streams them to a local React UI backed by a Dockerized SQLite server, with filtering, parent/subagent hierarchy, full session replay, and per-model token stats.

summary.one_liner: A real-time observability dashboard for Claude Code (and planned Codex) agents that streams hook events from a Dockerized SQLite server to a local React UI, installed as a Claude Code plugin.
use_cases: Watching live tool calls and subagent activity during Claude Code sessions
Tracing which subagent was spawned by which parent agent
Replaying a past Claude Code session event by event
Reviewing token usage and cost per session or model
Debugging a bad edit or destructive command after the fact
Searching and filtering events by agent or tool type
how_to_run: open http://localhost:4981 (default dashboard URL per README)
notable: Installs as a Claude Code plugin that auto-starts the server and captures hook events
Covers the full session lifecycle: tool calls, subagent start/stop, task and permission events
Shows agent parent/subagent hierarchy and full session replay
Per-model token usage and cost breakdowns in session stats (v0.9.7)
Agent-class-specific libs keep the server agent-neutral, with Codex support on the roadmap
caveats: Requires Docker, Node.js, and Bash on the host; the plugin fails to load without them
Codex, OpenClaw, and pi-code support are listed as unchecked roadmap items
Standalone setup needs manual hook configuration and the justfile toolchain
